# @kamui/sdk (vendored)

Source-only TypeScript SDK, copied from [`starknet-innovation/kamui`](https://github.com/starknet-innovation/kamui) at commit `a6e491c2a115ce5489ffbd6a45d93f3c1840afea`.

Licence: MIT (see `LICENSE`). Import from `src/`; this package is not published to npm.

To refresh:

```sh
# from a checkout of kamui at the commit you want
cp -a /path/to/kamui/sdk/src/. vendor/kamui-sdk/src/
```
